text.text: How does `offstage run` choose a lane and keep the work off your screen?

Engineers onboarding to offstage and offstage cloud · CLI/MCP classifies argv, refuses or dispatches to the headless, container or helper-session lane, writes result.json; plus direct session
verbs.
Developer's machine
User's own account (self-hosted): CLI/MCP process, lanes, Docker
Helper macOS session

Same Mac, separate uid
(computeruse) with its own
window server

offstage

router

(in place)

execa child in
caller's cwd, stdin
ignored, no
isolation; refuses
obvious --headed

Xvfb web
container

docker run --rm:
repo ro, artifacts rw,
Xvfb + fluxbox; host

Run dirs

Key: frames = trust/deployment zones; box = runtime actor/process; cylinder = stored state. Arrows: caller → recipient, response included; dotted (local) = file/IPC.
Routing: lane choice and cloud dispatch

classify() only reads argv/repo files: session >
container > headless. A refuse signal (installer,
.pkg/.dmg, hdiutil) blocks every lane, even with --lane;
--lane headless can't downgrade. Cloud submit checks
auth, GUI gate, capacity, credit; /claim serves
sandboxes, then fair-by-team tasks.

Source: src/router/index.ts, src/cli/api.ts,
cloud/src/api/app.ts, cloud/src/core/queue.ts
State and result lifecycle

Local: run() makes .offstage/runs/<id>; a zod-checked
LaneResult is saved best-effort as result.json. Cloud:
in-memory state is snapshotted atomically to
/data/plane.json every 2 s and on SIGTERM; a crash
can lose ~2 s of acked writes. Orphaned claims
requeue on restore; orphaned runs fail.

Source: src/contract/artifacts.ts, src/cli/api.ts,
cloud/src/server.ts, cloud/src/core/persist.ts
Failure, isolation and retry

Lanes never throw or use your screen: no substrate →
skipped (exit 69). sessiond checks peer uid; refuses
input on console. Cloud: unstarted claims requeue
after 20 s (3 tries); a box silent 2 min fails running
tasks, no rerun. Slots claim only behind a fail-closed pf
guard; reset gives a new uid.

Source: src/contract/index.ts, native/sessiond/Peer.swift,
native/sessiond/Input.swift, cloud/src/core/queue.ts,
src/fleet/lan-guard.ts, src/fleet/reset.ts
